okay, real talk —

We need to talk about student life.

Pressure Points is a real talk on real student life. It breaks the silence on stress, academic pressure, peer pressure, comparison, self-doubt, and the constant race to be perfect.

No boring lectures. Just real stories, real struggles, and real solutions — from students who've been in it, for students who are in it right now.
